claim.claim-text: 2. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein an actuation movement transmitted by the mechanical transmission elements to the at least one amplification element may be transmitted with some degree of amplification or reduction to the respective end-effector link.
3. The articulated instrument of claim 2, wherein the motion transmission from the amplification element to the end-effector link is made through a contact force.
4. The articulated instrument of claim 3, wherein the contact force is increased by the use of a geared geometry on both the end-effector links and the amplification element.

5. The articulated instrument of claim 2, wherein the motion transmission from the amplification element to the end-effector link is made through a linkage mechanism, comprising at least one rigid element.
6. The articulated instrument of claim 2, wherein the motion transmission from the amplification element to the end-effector link is made through at least one flexible element.
7. The articulated instrument of claim 6, wherein the at least one flexible element has constant-pitch geometry.

8. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein the mechanical transmission elements comprise elements with a flexible mechanical construction, selected from the group consisting of strings, ropes, belts and chains.

9. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein the rotating elements are placed on a proximal articulated handle configured to be directly controlled by the hand of a user, so that user movements are transmitted to the distal end-effector.

10. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein its proximal extremity can be attached to a mechanical platform, so that it is integrated as part of a master-slave telemanipulator, having the input motion of the rotating elements given by the movement of a proximal articulated handle.

11. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein its proximal extremity can be easily attached and detached from a mechanical platform, so that it is removably integrated as part of a master-slave telemanipulator,

12. The articulated instrument of claim 1, wherein its proximal extremity can be attached to a robotic platform, so that it is integrated as part of a master-slave robotic telemanipulator, having the input motion of the rotating elements given by the movement of a proximal articulated handle.
